description: Place your pouch, box or bottle artwork on a shelf, counter or cafe table before you order printed stock. Square packaging mockups from one photo.
h1: Packaging Mockup Generator for a Shelf or Cafe Scene
lead: Build a packaging mockup for a shelf, counter, or cafe from one photo of the pouch, box, or bottle. Add a voiceover and captions when that photo also becomes a clip.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo of the pouch, box or bottle you will ship. The shape in that photo stays the shape in the preview.
Name a shelf, counter or cafe setting. The credit cost is shown before the square preview is made.
Download the square file. It has no watermark. Compare it with your artwork and a printer proof before you approve production.

steps_h2: Make a Box Mockup from One Package Photo in 3 Steps
steps_lead: One photo of the real package, one scene, then a square file you compare with the printer proof.

faq.q: What is a packaging mockup generator?
faq.a: A square shelf, counter, or cafe preview from one photo of the pouch, box, or bottle you will ship. It shows presentation, not ink or legal text. That photo can also start a clip with an AI actor, a script, and a voiceover.

faq.q: How does the preview get made?
faq.a: Upload the package photo or paste a product page link, name the shelf scene, and download the square file. For a clip, add the script, voiceover, and captions in the built-in editor.

faq.q: Why use this instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: You can judge the shelf composition before a print order, and make a product clip without booking a creator. A printer proof still checks color and small legal text.
Food, drink, beauty, and home shops, plus agencies, that need a packaging mockup for a retailer deck, a listing concept, or a product clip.
Yes. One clear photo of the full package is enough. You do not need an editing background to set captions, music, or a spoken line on the clip.
Pouches, cartons, bottles, tins, jars, and bags work when the package shape is visible in the source photo. A pouch packaging mockup and a coffee packaging mockup both start that way.

faq.q: Can I upload my own pack photo?
faq.a: Yes. The photo of the package you will ship is the source. A design file by itself is not. A box mockup from a design photo still needs that real package in the frame.

faq.q: Where can I use the file?
faq.a: The square preview fits a listing concept, a deck, or a post. A clip from the same photo can go to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, or Shopify. Video frames include 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4.

faq.q: Do I need a paid plan?
faq.a: Yes. There is no free plan. Plans start at $24.50 a month. The square preview is 24 credits. A clip is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the cost first, and a failed job returns its credits. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I use the preview in a pitch or an ad?
faq.a: Yes. Use it in your store, a retailer deck, or an ad. It is not a substitute for a printer proof when color or fine print must be exact. Any person in a clip is an AI actor, not a buyer.

faq.q: Why start from a shelf scene instead of a blank frame?
faq.a: The shelf, counter, or cafe scene is already framed, so you compare variants faster. You can still make a second opening, speak another language, or call the catalog API for the next pack.
